beats.say: Rereading this stuff feels like studying until you just blank completely on the test.
Instead of spending hours making flashcards by hand, just drop your slides or typed notes right into Kiln.
It turns everything into actual exam questions and a deck you can actually get through.
Drop tonight's lecture notes into Kiln and quiz yourself before bed.
